name: panel-viewer
description: A production-quality, full-stack panel image viewer (Bun + Vite + React + Hono + PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/shared && tsc --noEmit && cd ../../apps/api && tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && bun x drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:studio: cd apps/api && bun x drizzle-kit studio
